method: Independent text-first review of ten coarse and ten current final texts in original case order. No coordinate/distance values viewed. Only after observations were made, exact SHA256 text hashes were matched to recorded quality entries. No new judge/LLM calls, model loads or services. This is one reviewer pass, not an estimated error rate or full factual audit.
important_limits: Cases are paired and not independent samples. Findings include inherited coarse defects as well as deterioration introduced later. Other paragraphs are not certified correct.

findings.quote: collapsing a superposition into a classical statistical mixture
findings.reason: Environmental decoherence suppresses interference in a reduced state through entanglement; it does not itself select an outcome or establish physical collapse. The reduced state is an improper mixture.
findings.suggested_correction: Describe suppression of observable interference and effective classical behavior without claiming collapse.

findings.current_assessment: no clear substantive defect identified in this pass
findings.reason: Readable generic quorum/log-replication explanation. Availability and failure-model assumptions are omitted, so it should not be promoted as a universal theorem.

findings.coarse_assessment: same causal conclusion plus duplicated words
findings.quote: allows for the determination of how structural changes directly drive gene expression
findings.reason: Combining binding/enrichment and transcriptomic maps yields associations; it does not by itself establish direct causal regulation. ChIP assays also need not all use sequencing. Coarse text contains the independent grammar failure "fragments fragments"; current text repairs that duplication but retains the causal overclaim.
findings.suggested_correction: Say the integration identifies candidate associations or hypotheses; require perturbation/functional evidence for causal claims.

findings.current_assessment: clear scientific definition error and grammar defect
findings.coarse_assessment: same definition error and grammar defect
findings.reason: Radiative forcing concerns changes in net radiative flux including shortwave AND longwave, rather than solar radiation alone. Both versions also end with "over time timescales", a malformed redundant phrase.
findings.suggested_correction: Use net radiative flux (shortwave plus longwave), and end with "over different timescales" or "over time".

findings.current_assessment: no clear substantive defect identified in this pass
findings.reason: Coherent paragraph; appropriately mentions gradient leakage rather than promising raw-data secrecy guarantees. No specific grammar failure found.

findings.quote: lets an autonomous agent to create
findings.reason: The causative verb let takes a bare infinitive: "lets an autonomous agent create". Current output also lowercases the paragraph opening and the next sentence ("this process"). The coarse version correctly says "allows an autonomous agent to build". This is a direct no-deterioration false pass. The categorical "must utilize loop closure" is additionally too broad for all localization/map-consistency architectures.
findings.suggested_correction: Restore "allows ... to build" or "lets ... build" and sentence capitalization; qualify loop closure as a common method.

findings.current_assessment: clarity concern; not counted as a clear false pass
findings.reason: Synaptic weight is a functional efficacy parameter; if morphological remodeling is intended, identify spine/bouton/synapse structural changes explicitly. The sentence does not make the proposed functional/structural distinction operational.

findings.coarse_assessment: clear duplication and missing sentence boundary
findings.reason: Current text fixes coarse "phases phases Analyzing" and inserts a sentence boundary, but replaces it with a tautological phrase. "Diffraction spectroscopy" also needs a specific actual measurement (e.g. X-ray diffraction), rather than a vague conflation of diffraction and spectroscopy. The paragraph blurs lattice phase transformations and grain-boundary motion. Treat these as editing/specialist-review needs rather than a proved false physical law.

findings.current_assessment: minor wording issue, not a clear false pass
findings.reason: The protocol/system maintains a safety invariant; the replacement "state" is less precise. Otherwise readable, and it acknowledges the consistency/availability tradeoff.

findings.current_assessment: oversimplified diagnostic description; not counted as clear false pass
findings.reason: Line widths/shifts alone do not generally identify all stated atmospheric parameters without line-strength/excitation/ionization information and model assumptions. Later mention of modeling partially qualifies the paragraph. No obvious grammar failure found.
